dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-body point toward the posterior peduncle, terminating at the fluke insertion.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical protrusion on the right lateral margin near the junction of the peduncle and fluke.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey/off-white median intensity; darker pigment along the central dorsal ridge and peduncle.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of small, dark-pixel clusters concentrated along the longitudinal axis of the dorsal ridge and the peduncle.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light-grey surface and the localized darker clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several small, circular dark pigmented spots along the dorsal midline.
